scope: Only fresh, private, empty R2NCTActivity and R2NCTActivity1 maintenance controls; new order/stock isolation authorized by user, not reuse of old initialization/type/UNKNOWN consent
preconditions: Server checks all twelve fixed R2 collections for complete private metadata and no business/unknown records before insertion; exact actual same Admin member, approved status, journal control fields and request identity; rechecks metadata/content before insert
writeLimit: At most one new MAINTENANCE control per company; no update/remove, no old tables, no business inventory records or ACTIVE; lost response propagates without retry
